stationScope.evidence: Germany EVSE CPO audit maps DE*EWP exclusively to Energie und Wasser Potsdam GmbH. Official EWP page explicitly distinguishes EWP own-network prices from separate roaming price bands.

roamingDeferred.reason: Official EWP page publishes separate roaming ranges (AC 0.59-0.89 EUR/kWh, DC 0.69-0.99 EUR/kWh). These are eMSP roaming prices and must not be attached to third-party physical CPOs.

adhocDeferred.reason: Official current EWP page says EchtMobil is cheaper than AdHoc charging but does not publish an exact current AdHoc tariff on that page. No AdHoc fallback is inferred.

note: Current official EWP EchtMobil page, revalidated 2026-09-04, still publishes prices effective 2024-05-01: 0.52 EUR/kWh AC and 0.62 EUR/kWh DC on EWP charge points. Time fee is 0.10 EUR/min after 240 minutes AC or 90 minutes DC, capped at 30 EUR/session; EchtMobil contract customers at EWP points in Potsdam and surroundings are exempt from the time fee 20:00-06:00. RFID card has a one-time 10 EUR handling/shipping fee after free app registration.
